metas.name: ★ 8.4 · 1954 · Rear Window
metas.description: A bored photographer recovering from a broken leg passes the time by watching his neighbors and begins to suspect one of them of murder.

metas.name: ★ 8.4 · 1957 · Witness for the Prosecution
metas.description: A veteran British barrister must defend his client in a murder trial that has surprise after surprise.

metas.name: ★ 8.2 · 1958 · Vertigo
metas.description: A former San Francisco police detective juggles wrestling with his personal demons and becoming obsessed with the hauntingly beautiful woman he has been hired to trail, who may be deeply disturbed.

metas.name: ★ 8.1 · 1954 · Dial M for Murder
metas.description: A London playboy plots the perfect murder of his rich, unfaithful wife.

metas.name: ★ 8.1 · 1950 · Rashomon
metas.description: Three parties and a witness have four versions of a rape/murder in ninth-century Japan.

metas.name: ★ 8.0 · 1959 · Anatomy of a Murder
metas.description: An upstate Michigan lawyer defends a soldier who claims he killed an innkeeper due to temporary insanity after the victim raped his wife. What is the truth and will he win his case?

metas.name: ★ 7.9 · 1950 · In a Lonely Place
metas.description: A potentially violent screenwriter is a murder suspect until his lovely neighbor clears him. However, she soon starts to have her doubts.

metas.name: ★ 7.6 · 1955 · Bad Day at Black Rock
metas.description: Following World War II, a one-armed stranger arrives in a tiny California desert town, but finds the residents hostile and protecting a terrible secret they want to keep hidden, by violent means if necessary.

metas.name: ★ 7.4 · 1955 · To Catch a Thief
metas.description: A retired jewel thief sets out to prove his innocence after being suspected of returning to his former occupation.

metas.name: ★ 7.4 · 1956 · The Man Who Knew Too Much
metas.description: An American doctor and his wife, a former singing star, witness a murder while vacationing in Morocco, and are drawn into a twisting plot of international intrigue when their young son is kidnapped.

metas.name: ★ 7.0 · 1955 · The Trouble with Harry
metas.description: Harry's dead and, while no one really minds, everyone feels responsible. After Harry's body is found in the woods, several locals must determine not only how and why he was killed but what to do with the body.
